en: Sepia-toned vintage view of a wide, gently curving path running through a densely wooded park or garden. Low rustic wooden fences made of crossed stakes border both sides of the path. Mature leafy trees create a canopy overhead, with dappled light falling on the ground. Two children stand on the pathway, one closer to the foreground and another further down the path. There are no visible buildings or monuments and no visible printed caption on the front.
